main_body: round leaf canopy (rows 1-29) on a short brown trunk with root flare (rows 30-46)
top_band: light green #72b448 rows 2-4 at x=8 (upper-left of the dome); at the centre column only a 1-row highlight at row 2 over darker greens
evidence: This is an organic tree, so it is judged as a volume rather than a flat object. The canopy is a rounded dome lit from the top-left. The lighter top rows give way to darker greens below, and the darkest greens sit under the canopy where it shades the trunk. The trunk is a vertical south face with a lit left side and a darker right side, and the roots flare at the base. No receding side face and no flat elevation. The top band is weak at the centre column, but a dome canopy reads as a lit top over a front mass.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile. The references have 427 and 567 colours and a median of about 108 per tile. The canopy is a smooth block-shaded dome with no leaf clumps, no per-leaf highlights and no branch detail, so it looks far thinner than the references. Dark edge pixels are 95% neutral, so the outline is a near-black sticker line, while the references' outlines carry a material tint (0% neutral). The trunk is a simple two-tone column with little grain. There are no flat 5x5 fills, but the piece is clearly much poorer than the references in density and craft.
